limits: Research prototype, not production qualification or independent human review.
Hosted default cell is the recorded Python 3.12 build interpreter; Python 3.13 is separate local evidence.
Three frozen earlier-reader controls may be explicitly unavailable in hosted JSONB receipts; skips do not qualify compatibility.
Google SDK checks use local protocol transport and real PostgreSQL; they do not prove live cloud custody.
OpenBao is a single-node pinned local qualification service with its recorded TLS/audit/storage boundary.
Fresh recovery restart controls deny Cryptalis imports; they do not prove a separately package-uninstalled interpreter.
Fresh recovery retains existing JSONB, application, Project, integer public-slot and search modification profile scope; it does not separately exercise parameterized UPDATE after restore.
Project recovery command is a retained release step; its dedicated phase receipts are not selected into the uploaded artifact.
No workflow rerun, cancellation, repository edit, local database probe/test, commit, push or publication was performed by this hosted audit.
The separate earlier VARCHAR InternalError cause remains UNKNOWN and is not cleared by these successful runs.
